S.FORM: alang Paridrayan ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Santimon go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 229 buwan, 733 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 98% kyan ku 718 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 2% kyan ku 15 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 95%, Rukay 1%, Bunun 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkyahu' na Paridrayan hya' ga Tjusepayuan. tay 'zil na Paridrayan hya' ga Cavak. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san "tuqi'"qu spzyang glgang nha qalang musa' ana inu'. basu kisya' glgan ungat kisya' nya'. spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ pari*rajan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu [s|ɕ]antimon ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** rukaj * βunun * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkjaħuʔ na pari*rajan ħjaʔ ɣa tju[s|ɕ]epajuan taj ʔzil na pari*rajan ħjaʔ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]a*ak reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an tuqiʔqu [s|ɕ]pzjaŋ ɣlɣaŋ nħa qalaŋ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ana inuʔ βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan uŋat ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ njaʔ [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
